headline: SABIC Agri-Nutrients takes FID on Jubail ammonia-urea complex with an integrated large-scale carbon-capture unit
summary: SABIC Agri-Nutrients approved a final investment decision and awarded a US$3.47bn EPC contract to Samsung E&A for a new ammonia and urea complex in Jubail, Saudi Arabia (1.2 Mtpa ammonia via KBR technology; two urea plants totalling 2.6 Mtpa, lifting SABIC AN urea capacity 54% to 7.4 Mtpa), with an integrated large-scale carbon-capture unit using Shell Global Solutions technology to cut the complex's emissions intensity.
co2crc_note: A Gulf blue-ammonia/urea FID that bundles capture into the plant design (Shell tech) is a signal on integrated-capture project economics relevant to Australia's blue-ammonia export ambitions and capture-vendor landscape.
extractor_note: US$3.47bn is the whole ammonia-urea complex EPC contract, not CCS-unit-specific spend, and no CO2 capture capacity (Mtpa) was stated, so amount and capacity_mtpa left null per the project-cost / no-figure rules.

headline: Whirlpool assembles a diversified carbon-removal portfolio through ClimeFi across four CDR pathways in the US and Brazil
summary: Whirlpool Corporation procured a diversified durable carbon-removal portfolio via portfolio manager ClimeFi, spanning four suppliers and pathways — CREW Carbon (marine CDR), Gevo (biogenic carbon capture & storage), InPlanet (enhanced weathering, Brazil) and Liferaft (biochar) — combining firm offtake agreements with fixed-price options that reserve future supply.
co2crc_note: A multinational buyer taking a multi-pathway durable-CDR portfolio (incl. a Bio-CCS slice) is a demand-side signal for the voluntary CDR market that underpins some Australian BECCS/CCS project economics.
extractor_note: No total dollar value or tonnage for Whirlpool's slice was disclosed, so amount and capacity_mtpa left null; enhanced weathering and biochar mapped to nearest value_chain tokens (mineralisation).
